sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Bukijutsu, Fuinjutsu, Earth Release, Water Release

system.description:
You have no fears of getting in close to brawl as you bring with you countless strikes. As part of an attack made when you take the Attack action or a Jutsu you cast that make an attack, you can cast this jutsu. When you do, you conjure the true inspiration of the Arms of Buddha ninjutsu, a countless barrage of verdant fists and palms.

Make a melee Ninjutsu or Taijutsu attack comparing the result against the AC of all creatures within 10 feet of you. On a hit, you deal 2d12 Earth, Cold or Chakra damage and each affected creature must make a constitution saving throw, being Concussed on a failed save from the barrage of strikes or no further effects on a success.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, and the damage by 1d12. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the size of the affected area by +5 feet. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, increase size of the affected area by +5 feet.
